No new UI functionality.

Primary lower-left and distance/range lower-right stones still remain muted RED for 回旋镖 and BLUE for 控物, NOT grey. Leave aged bronze rim and central paintings similar. Skill upper icon / lower engraved Chinese name mandatory. Every numeral and Chinese name is visibly INCised below the surface, with sloping bright chisel walls and darker cavity floor; no metal numeral inlay, no raised or printed text.
Improve semantic OUTER SHAPES: upper-left entire stone must have an unmistakable compact BOOT PROFILE silhouette, broad ankle upper part for large 4/3 numeral and short toe extending right at the bottom. NOT an octagon with a boot icon on top. Upper-right whole stone remains SHIELD-shaped with 3/5. Lower-left primary attack stone actual wide short SWORD shape with broad crossguard and short blade containing 3, muted red stone, compact enough to stay in disc footprint. Lower-left blue spell primary is a compact HAND/ARCANE CREST silhouette and just a spell-hand engraving without any number. Lower-right attack-distance outer silhouette is a compact broad SPEAR-TIP shield, RED stone, precise engraved small crosshair intersected by diagonal spear in top area, 3 beneath separated with breathing room. Lower-right blue RANGE stone must be ROUND like a circular stone ripple with two CONCENTRIC CIRCLE engravings above 2. Keep simple concentric CIRCLES, do NOT put a crosshair/cross or spear in this icon. Bottom-center GREY hourglass-shaped 9 on each disc. All badges hug rim and fit full circular button bounding square. The names "回旋镖" / "控物" stay legible and not overlapped.
Bottom three enlarged GREY shield examples still 6 / 8 / 4 labelled "原值" / "增加" / "减少". 6 is carved neutral; 8 has vivid emerald GREEN magic filling the channel floor with a couple of flowing luminous veins INSIDE the shape; 4 has ruby RED magic on same recessed cavity floor. Slightly brighter magic than prior image, but absolutely no glow across the stone, no flame/sparks outside numeral, dark neutral separator walls prevent green/red spreading to border. Make this an impressive deeply tactile hand-crafted fantasy game UI with truly stone-carved digits.
Keep exact right-side labels "攻击距离" and "技能范围"; footer "概念样式 · 尚未实装". Baseline values on discs untouched, top movement4 defense3 attack3 distance3 initiative9; lower movement3 defense5 skill NO NUMBER range2 initiative9. Only material, stricter silhouettes and magic-fill treatment change.

Fine subtitle "石色识别卡牌 · 魔力识别增减". Six clear large panels, TWO columns THREE rows; restrained borders and generous spacing for phone viewing. All text Chinese crisp; only text listed here. Never raise numbers above their stone.
TOP LEFT: exact compact RED STONE primary ATTACK sword-shaped badge, fully seen with broad blade/crossguard. Number 4 carved INTO blade and GREEN glowing magic liquid filling bottom of its cavity; dark neutral cut walls separate green from red. Label "红牌 · 数值增加". The tile itself MUST stay RED; no green wash on stone or border.
TOP RIGHT: GREEN STONE primary SKILL badge broad hand/flame crest silhouette, small hand glyph above numeral; large deeply cut 2 filled with RED magic. Label "绿牌 · 数值减少". Green stone remains GREEN, magic only within numeral2.
MIDDLE LEFT: GREY stone wide-waisted hourglass badge with large deeply carved exact "-2". Minus must be a separate clear full-depth groove, roomy enough. Neutral stone cuts not glowing, definitely recessed. Label "负先攻". To its side within same cell place second smaller wide hourglass with deeply carved exact "12", label "双位数". MIDDLE RIGHT: large GREY stone shield containing exact deeply carved infinity "∞", neutral cavity with pale bevels. Label "条件防御". Do not write 8; infinity must lie horizontally.

BOTTOM RIGHT: BLUE compact broad SPEARHEAD-shaped stone badge. Top portion a simple carved crosshair circle with ONLY two short targeting ticks, with an unmistakable diagonal SPEAR running through that circle, not a sword, not an arrow flight. Bottom portion large deeply carved 3 separated from icon. Same blue stone color as bottom-left, SAME numeric material to emphasize glyph shape difference, no glow. Label "攻击距离 · 准星长矛". Distinguishable from concentric ring range even in monochrome.
Stone grain restrained; avoid fractures cutting through number strokes. Macro render clarity shows cavities as physically below face, chisel sidewall shadows. Magic behaves as liquid light at recessed floor, no outside particle firework. Bottom caption "示意数值 · 非新增规则 · 尚未实装". No surrounding ability circle, no battlefield, no new values or bonus rules, no unnecessary English.
